divisions.name: Creative and Design
divisions.purpose: Decide what the game is, why it exists, how it plays and what the player sees and feels.

divisions.name: Graphics and Audio
divisions.purpose: Produce every visible and audible asset, from models and materials to lighting, effects, sound and score.

divisions.name: Engineering
divisions.purpose: Own the engine, the runtime, the code that makes systems real and the data that keeps a game alive.

divisions.name: Specialised Game Systems
divisions.purpose: Own the genre-defining mechanics: shooting, strategy, construction, mining, survival, vehicles and generation.

divisions.name: Simulation and World Systems
divisions.purpose: Keep the world believable over time: economies, societies and dynamic environmental systems.

divisions.name: QA, Production and Operations
divisions.purpose: Prove the game works, make it fast on real hardware, keep it safe and ship it on schedule.

divisions.name: Studio Research and Innovation
divisions.purpose: Continuously discover engines, rendering techniques, AI systems, licensed asset libraries, optimisation methods and tooling, and turn findings into adoptable proposals.
